sources.title: California Berry Cultivars - visible cultivar index and product pages
sources.enumerated_scope: All eleven indexed product labels in the unfiltered English Home view, each checked on its individual product page.
sources.limitations: The company homepage says 12+ cultivars. Eleven visible products do not account for that minimum or its lifetime portfolio. Comparison names, traits, trials and growing regions are separate unreviewed context. No aliases, release dates, rights, company roles or photos are approved. Comparator labels Monterey, Cabrillo, Fronteras, Portola, Ruby June, San andreas and Bounty are not counted as CBC products.

sources.limitations: The seventh label AVA Dalacia has no independently established berry/identity in this carousel. AVA Dalicia and AVA Alicia are separate literal labels, not approved aliases. Homepage Magnum is outside this carousel and has unresolved crop/current-release scope. Brand graphics are not fruit photos and reuse is not established.
